subject: Launch resourcing, escalation plan & exec-readout request
messages:
From: Katherine Chong <katherine@acme-retail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-retail-contracts@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood pilot -> launch readiness questions

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

We have our QBR with procurement + platform ops on 9/21 and procurement asked for a short executive readout from Redwood covering readiness across GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support. They want any outstanding resource gaps and an escalation plan if certain milestones slip.

Can you provide a 1-page exec summary and a short list of high-risk items by EOD Thursday (9/16)? If there are any contract or SLA items that need to be elevated, please include the points and the contact we should loop in.

Thanks — Katherine
Katherine Chong
Director, Platform Integrations
Acme Retail

--
Attachment: acme-contracts-qbr-agenda.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Katherine Chong <katherine@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood pilot -> launch readiness questions

Katherine — thanks for the heads up.

Marissa / Laura / Vivek: looping you in to pull the brief together. Goal: single-slide exec summary + 3 bullet risk list + owners. Katherine asked for EOD Thu (9/16).

Quick asks from my side:
- Marissa: short enablement cadence + docs readiness (content gaps, trainer headcount).
- Laura: GTM readiness & channel enablement — is our customer success coverage mapped for the expected ramp?
- Vivek: support SLA / escalation plan + on-call coverage matrix (weekend + peak-release window).
- Everyone: flag any pricing or contract items that need legal/procurement escalation (cc Karthik if needed).

I'll consolidate into a 1-page PDF and share back by Thursday morning for rapid review. If anyone cannot meet the EOD ask, please call out what you can deliver and when.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: request-template.docx (docx stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Katherine Chong <katherine@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot -> launch readiness questions

Thanks Rachel. Quick status from Enablement / Docs: 

- Enablement: pilot-trainer team is staffed for initial ramp (2 FTEs) but we need 1 additional trainer for week-of-launch shadowing. We can hit basic playbook coverage by 9/20 if we get headcount commit by 9/17.
- Docs: core integration guides ready; missing two runbook sections: "Rollback play" and "KV cache tuning for retail workloads". ETA to complete: 9/18 with assigned owner (Ava Chen).
- Training artifacts: demo deck & hands-on lab in progress; will attach tracker.

Risks: trainer headcount, runbook gaps, and availability of a customer technical contact for live verification during the first week.

I will attach the enablement tracker and a short gap matrix to my next note.

-Marissa
Sr. Manager, Enablement
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: enablement-tracker.csv (csv stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot -> launch readiness questions

Quick pricing note — we expect a discount approval ask from procurement if they want committed reserved capacity for Dedicated. If procurement asks for a three-tier commit (dev/staging/prod), legal will want a term sheet and pricing deck. I can draft a short pricing-impact note, but I need expected monthly token volume by 9/17 to make the numbers concrete.

Also, if we allow an early ramp credit, leadership sign-off is required. Recommend we pre-authorize a $20k credit cap scoped to onboarding issues only.

-Karthik
Head of Pricing & Commercials
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Katherine Chong <katherine@acme-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Consolidated: Exec readout & escalation plan (draft)

Folks — attached is a draft 1-page exec readout for the Acme QBR. Summary highlights and asks up top; risk table + owners below. High-level boil down:

- GTM: channel plan ready; need CS coverage details from Laura (action: Laura by 9/17).
- Enablement/Docs: two doc runbook items and +1 trainer needed (action: Marissa by 9/17).
- Pricing: potential procurement ask for reserved capacity; asked Karthik for numbers (action: Karthik by 9/17).
- Support: Vivek to confirm weekend + PST coverage and escalation contact (action: Vivek by 9/17).

Escalation plan (brief): If any critical milestone misses 9/18 completion (runbook/trainer/CS mapping):
1) Notify Rachel -> Rachel will escalate to Head of Ops and Legal (Karthik in copy).
2) Trigger optional 1-week limited ramp delay or rollback plan led by Laura.
3) Activate emergency onboarding credit (cap $20k) only with exec approval.

Please review the attached draft and add inline comments by 5pm PST today so I can produce a final PDF for Katherine tomorrow AM.

Thanks — Rachel

--
Attachment: launch-readout-exec-brief-v1.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Consolidated: Exec readout & escalation plan (draft)

Thanks Rachel — quick confirmation from Support side:
- Weekend on-call is covered for 9/20–9/27 (PST follow-the-sun backup in place).
- Escalation contact: Vivek Kulkarni (on-call lead) + support-escalations@redwood.ai.
- I'll attach the coverage matrix in the final version. No blockers on our end aside from the trainer headcount noted by Marissa.

Vivek
